main_text.l: Martialis appellatione usus, qui Gerres dixerunt. Est autem Smaris ea Mænæ
species, quæ Leucomænis etiam à Græcis dicitur, id est, Mæna alba, quia semper alba
remanet, cùm Mæna prior colorem mutet. Eundem piscem Garum esse, nominis affinitas facit, ut suspicer, cum pro Garo
Cerrus dicatur: & à Plinio & Martiali multitudinis numero Gerres, & Antipoli
hodie Garon. præterea ex hoc piscículo optimum fieri garum experientia docet, ex Garo
verò pisce optimum fieri garum testis est Plinius, Rondeletius. Leucomænides aliqui Boaces nominât, Athenæus.
Smarides vocantur etiam Marides Athenæo.
Smaridem, Bocam & Mænam cognatos pisces, sic distingues. Boca liturís
caret, quibus Smaris prædita est. Smaris quoq; asperiores fert squamas: lineasq; rectas, serie quadam
in lateribus dispositas, quales & in Mæna cernimus: sed Mæna nullo seruato ordine confusas, Bellonius.
GRAECI hodicq; Marides aut Smarides appellant.
ITAL. Neapoli, Cerres. Venetijs, Girolí, Gerruli, alijs etiam Giri, Zerli, Romæ Spígaro: u-
bi & Rotonetum aliqui vocant, quod nomen Boopi debetur. Siculi etiamnum Smaridas vocant.
HISPANICE Picarel. Vide mox in Gallicis.
GALL. Massiliæ, Gerres vel Giarets. In Gallia
Narbonensi, ut & in Hispania, Picarel: ob id fortasse
quòd salitus hic piscis & fumo exiccatus, linguam acri-
monia quadam pungit & mordet, Rondeletius.
GERM. F. Ein wysser Scheysserling, vel imitatio
ne Hispanis & in Prouincia usitati nominis Picarel, ein
Bitzling. Bitzelen enim nostris de sapore pungente
& mordente linguam in usu est. Mænulam Italorum
à Germanis inferioribus Houtinck vocari olim accepi,
quod si verum est, Smaridem seu Leucomænidem
interpretabimur ein wysser Houtinck:
Et Boopis species
duas aut tres, geschlachte des Houtinckes/ oder des
nåchstgemelten fisches.
BOOPS, Box, Boax. Βόωψ, Βώξ, Βόαξ.
DHic piscis litoralis est, ex Mænarum genere: in
Gallia nostra Narbonensi, Italia, Hispania, & re & no-
mine notissimus. A Plinio Box dicitur, uel (ut alij le-
gunt) Boca. Gaza Vocam conuertit,
Rondeletius.
GRAECI hodie❦ Boopa nominant.

page.notes: The woodcut shows a fish head and body; it is not text. Some German words are in black letter and are marked as such. Lower edge of the page is cut off in this part. The first letter of the paragraph is a large woodcut initial "B" with the rest of the word "Hic" in small capitals; the head line is set in small capitals with Greek words. The "ITAL;" line is a printed label at lower right. The Greek line is reproduced in Latin transliteration only where the printing is unclear; the Greek forms were read as printed.
